label: Actual esse-cause responsibility composes along actual cause links
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For any a, b and c in one q3 profile: if a is actual as to esse, a causes the esse of b, and b is an actual distinct cause of the actual c in that same esse respect (ActualEsseCause), then a causes the esse of c. This is an open analyst composition law for causal responsibility, not a definition of causation, intervention dependence or temporal origination. No source existence, participant actuality, OwnBeing or selection follows from it alone.
